source.text: וָאָשׁ֕וּב וָאֶשָּׂ֥א עֵינַ֖י וָֽאֶרְאֶ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֖ה מְגִלָּ֥ה עָפָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I returned and lifted up my eyes and saw, and look, a scroll flying.

en.L: And again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and look, a flying scroll!
en.B: Again I looked up, and I saw a flying scroll.
en.R: I looked up again and saw a scroll flying through the air.

es.L: Y otra vez alcé mis ojos y miré, y he aquí un rollo que volaba.
es.B: Otra vez alcé la vista, y vi un rollo que volaba.
es.R: Levanté otra vez la vista y vi un rollo que volaba por el aire.

fr.L: Et de nouveau je levai les yeux et je regardai, et voici, un rouleau qui volait !
fr.B: De nouveau, je levai les yeux, et je vis un rouleau qui volait.
fr.R: J’ai de nouveau levé les yeux et j’ai vu un rouleau qui volait dans les airs.

sw.L: Nikainua macho yangu tena, nikaona, na tazama, gombo linaloruka!
sw.B: Tena nikatazama juu, nikaona gombo linaloruka.
sw.R: Nikatazama juu tena nikaona gombo likiruka hewani.

vi.L: Tôi lại ngước mắt lên và nhìn, và kìa, một cuộn sách bay!
vi.B: Tôi lại ngước mắt lên và thấy một cuộn sách đang bay.
vi.R: Tôi lại nhìn lên và thấy một cuộn sách đang bay trên không trung.

ko.L: 내가 다시 눈을 들어 보니, 보라, 날아가는 두루마리가 [있었다]!
ko.B: 내가 다시 눈을 들어 보니 날아가는 두루마리가 보였다.
ko.R: 내가 다시 위를 쳐다보니 두루마리 하나가 공중을 날아가고 있었다.

decisions.choice: the sixth vision: a flying scroll, the curse that removes thieves and perjurers from the land
decisions.reason: Zechariah sees a huge scroll flying, and the angel explains it as the curse that goes out over the land against those who steal and those who swear falsely (verses 3-4). The vision follows the cleansing of the high priest (chapter 3): now wrongdoing is purged from the land itself. The next vision (verses 5-11) carries wickedness away altogether.

decisions.choice: a scroll: a long sheet of leather or papyrus, written on and rolled up
decisions.reason: Books were written on scrolls (Jeremiah 36:2). This one is unrolled, so that it can be seen flying. Ezekiel saw a scroll written on front and back with lament and woe (Ezekiel 2:9-10).

decisions.choice: I returned and lifted up my eyes: I looked up again
decisions.reason: The verb "returned" is used with another verb to mean doing something again. On "lifted up my eyes", see 2:1.

decisions.choice: Again I looked up (B); I looked up again (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "looked up" for the idiom, as in 2:1, and Readable adds "through the air" to make the picture plain.

decisions.choice: "un rollo que volaba"
decisions.reason: The term sheet's "un rollo que vuela", put in the past of the narrative; the verb "volver" with "alzar" is given as "otra vez" (m3).

decisions.choice: the vision narrated in the passé simple at L and B ("je levai", "je vis") and the passé composé at R ("j'ai levé", "j'ai vu")
decisions.reason: Zechariah's visions are first-person narrative, as set for French in these books; what is said in them stays speech.

decisions.choice: "gombo linaloruka"
decisions.reason: "Gombo" is the word for a scroll in the Swahili prophets (Jeremiah 36:2); the participle "linaloruka" keeps the picture of the scroll in flight.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י מָ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה רֹאֶ֑ה וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲנִ֤י רֹאֶה֙ מְגִלָּ֣ה עָפָ֔ה אָרְכָּהּ֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרָחְבָּ֖הּ עֶ֥שֶׂר בָּאַמָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to me, What [are] you seeing? And I said, I [am] seeing a scroll flying; its length twenty by the cubit, and its width ten by the cubit.

en.L: And he said to me, "What do you see?" And I said, "I see a scroll flying; its length [is] twenty by the cubit, and its width ten by the cubit."
en.B: He asked me, "What do you see?" I answered, "A flying scroll, {{units:about thirty feet|twenty cubits}} long and {{units:about fifteen feet|ten cubits}} wide."
en.R: He asked me, "What do you see?" I said, "I see a flying scroll. It is {{units:about thirty feet|twenty cubits}} long and {{units:about fifteen feet|ten cubits}} wide."

es.L: Y me dijo: «¿Qué ves?». Y dije: «Veo un rollo que vuela; su longitud [es] de veinte codos, y su anchura de diez codos».
es.B: Me preguntó: «¿Qué ves?». Respondí: «Un rollo que vuela, de {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}} de largo y {{units:unos 4,5 metros|diez codos}} de ancho».
es.R: Me preguntó: «¿Qué ves?». Le dije: «Veo un rollo que vuela. Mide {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}} de largo y {{units:unos 4,5 metros|diez codos}} de ancho».

fr.L: Et il me dit : « Que vois-tu ? » Et je dis : « Je vois un rouleau qui vole ; sa longueur [est] de vingt coudées, et sa largeur de dix coudées. »
fr.B: Il me demanda : « Que vois-tu ? » Je répondis : « Un rouleau qui vole, long de {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}} et large de {{units:environ 4,50 mètres|dix coudées}}. »
fr.R: Il m’a demandé : « Que vois-tu ? » J’ai dit : « Je vois un rouleau qui vole. Il mesure {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}} de long et {{units:environ 4,50 mètres|dix coudées}} de large. »

sw.L: Naye akaniambia, "Unaona nini?" Nikasema, "Ninaona gombo linaloruka; urefu wake [ni] dhiraa ishirini, na upana wake dhiraa kumi."
sw.B: Akaniuliza, "Unaona nini?" Nikajibu, "Gombo linaloruka, urefu wake {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}} na upana wake {{units:karibu mita 4.5|dhiraa kumi}}."
sw.R: Akaniuliza, "Unaona nini?" Nikasema, "Ninaona gombo linaloruka. Urefu wake ni {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}} na upana wake ni {{units:karibu mita 4.5|dhiraa kumi}}."

vi.L: Thiên sứ nói với tôi: "Ông thấy gì?" Tôi đáp: "Tôi thấy một cuộn sách bay; bề dài nó hai mươi cu-đê, và bề rộng nó mười cu-đê."
vi.B: Thiên sứ hỏi tôi: "Ông thấy gì?" Tôi đáp: "Một cuộn sách đang bay, dài {{units:khoảng 9 m|hai mươi cu-đê}} và rộng {{units:khoảng 4,5 m|mười cu-đê}}."
vi.R: Thiên sứ hỏi tôi: "Ông thấy gì?" Tôi nói: "Tôi thấy một cuộn sách đang bay. Nó dài {{units:khoảng 9 m|hai mươi cu-đê}} và rộng {{units:khoảng 4,5 m|mười cu-đê}}."

ko.L: 그가 나에게 말하였다. "너는 무엇을 보느냐?" 내가 말하였다. "날아가는 두루마리를 봅니다. 그 길이는 이십 규빗이고, 그 너비는 십 규빗입니다."
ko.B: 그가 나에게 물었다. "무엇이 보이느냐?" 내가 대답했다. "날아가는 두루마리가 보입니다. 길이가 {{units:약 9미터|이십 규빗}}, 너비가 {{units:약 4.5미터|십 규빗}}입니다."
ko.R: 그가 나에게 물었다. "무엇이 보이느냐?" 내가 말했다. "날아가는 두루마리가 보입니다. 길이는 {{units:약 9미터|이십 규빗}}이고 너비는 {{units:약 4.5미터|십 규빗}}입니다."

decisions.choice: twenty cubits by ten: about thirty feet by fifteen, an enormous scroll
decisions.reason: A cubit was about 18 inches (see Genesis 6:15). No real scroll was so wide: this one is meant to be seen from far off by everyone. Its measurements are those of the porch in front of Solomon's temple (1 Kings 6:3), and some take the likeness to mean that the curse goes out from the LORD's presence. The angel does not explain the size.

decisions.choice: about thirty feet (twenty cubits); about fifteen feet (ten cubits)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the size in modern measures with the units setting, and the cubits as its alternative. Literal keeps the cubits.

decisions.choice: "{{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}}", "{{units:unos 4,5 metros|diez codos}}"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the size in metres with the units setting, worked out on the ordinary cubit of about 45 cm, as Daniel 3:1 does (twenty cubits about 9 metres, ten about 4,5); Literal keeps the cubits.

decisions.choice: "{{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}}", "{{units:environ 4,50 mètres|dix coudées}}"
decisions.reason: Metric by default, on the ordinary cubit of about 45 cm, as Daniel 3:1; Literal keeps the coudées.

decisions.choice: "{{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}", "{{units:karibu mita 4.5|dhiraa kumi}}"
decisions.reason: Metres by default on the ordinary cubit of about 45 cm, as Daniel 3:1 in Swahili; Literal keeps "dhiraa".

decisions.choice: "{{units:khoảng 9 m|hai mươi cu-đê}}", "{{units:khoảng 4,5 m|mười cu-đê}}"
decisions.reason: Metres by default on the ordinary cubit of about 45 cm, as Daniel 3:1 in Vietnamese; Literal keeps "cu-đê".

decisions.choice: "{{units:약 9미터|이십 규빗}}", "{{units:약 4.5미터|십 규빗}}"
decisions.reason: The term sheet's figures for this verse, on the standard cubit of 45 cm (Korean converts to metric where the English gives feet); Literal keeps 규빗.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י זֹ֚את הָֽאָלָ֔ה הַיּוֹצֵ֖את עַל־פְּנֵ֣י כָל־הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֣י כָל־הַגֹּנֵ֗ב מִזֶּה֙ כָּמ֣וֹהָ נִקָּ֔ה וְכָל־הַנִּ֨שְׁבָּ֔ע מִזֶּ֖ה כָּמ֥וֹהָ נִקָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to me, This [is] the curse which [is] going out over [the] face of all the land; for every one stealing, from here according to it has been purged, and every one swearing, from here according to it has been purged.

en.L: And he said to me, "This [is] the curse that is going forth over the face of the whole land; for everyone who steals will be purged out from here according to it, and everyone who swears will be purged out from here according to it.
en.B: Then he said to me, "This is the curse that is going out over the whole land. As one side of it says, every thief will be swept away; and as the other side says, everyone who swears falsely will be swept away.
en.R: Then he said to me, "This is the curse that is going out over the whole land. One side of the scroll says that everyone who steals will be removed from the land. The other side says that everyone who swears falsely will be removed too.

es.L: Y me dijo: «Esta [es] la maldición que sale sobre la faz de toda la tierra; porque todo el que roba será limpiado de aquí conforme a ella, y todo el que jura será limpiado de aquí conforme a ella.
es.B: Luego me dijo: «Esta es la maldición que sale sobre toda la tierra. Según lo que dice un lado del rollo, todo ladrón será barrido; y según lo que dice el otro lado, todo el que jura en falso será barrido.
es.R: Luego me dijo: «Esta es la maldición que sale sobre toda la tierra. Un lado del rollo dice que todo el que roba será quitado de la tierra. El otro lado dice que todo el que jura en falso será quitado también.

fr.L: Et il me dit : « C’est la malédiction qui sort sur la face de tout le pays ; car tout voleur sera balayé d’ici selon elle, et quiconque jure sera balayé d’ici selon elle.
fr.B: Puis il me dit : « C’est la malédiction qui se répand sur tout le pays. Selon ce qui est écrit d’un côté, tout voleur sera chassé ; et selon ce qui est écrit de l’autre côté, quiconque fait un faux serment sera chassé.
fr.R: Ensuite il m’a dit : « C’est la malédiction qui se répand sur tout le pays. Un côté du rouleau dit que tous ceux qui volent seront chassés du pays. L’autre côté dit que tous ceux qui font de faux serments seront chassés eux aussi.

sw.L: Naye akaniambia, "Hii [ndiyo] laana inayotoka juu ya uso wa nchi yote; kwa maana kila aibaye ataondolewa kutoka hapa kwa kadiri yake, na kila aapaye ataondolewa kutoka hapa kwa kadiri yake.
sw.B: Kisha akaniambia, "Hii ndiyo laana inayotoka juu ya nchi yote. Kama upande mmoja wake unavyosema, kila mwizi atafagiliwa mbali; na kama upande mwingine unavyosema, kila aapaye kwa uongo atafagiliwa mbali.
sw.R: Kisha akaniambia, "Hii ndiyo laana inayotoka juu ya nchi yote. Upande mmoja wa gombo unasema kwamba kila mtu anayeiba ataondolewa katika nchi. Upande mwingine unasema kwamba kila mtu anayeapa kwa uongo ataondolewa pia.

vi.L: Thiên sứ nói với tôi: "Đây [là] lời nguyền rủa đi ra trên khắp mặt xứ; vì mọi kẻ trộm cắp sẽ bị quét sạch khỏi đây theo nó, và mọi kẻ thề sẽ bị quét sạch khỏi đây theo nó.
vi.B: Rồi thiên sứ nói với tôi: "Đây là lời nguyền rủa đi ra trên khắp xứ. Theo như một mặt của cuộn sách, mọi kẻ trộm sẽ bị quét sạch; và theo như mặt kia, mọi kẻ thề dối sẽ bị quét sạch.
vi.R: Rồi thiên sứ nói với tôi: "Đây là lời nguyền rủa đi ra trên khắp xứ. Một mặt cuộn sách nói rằng mọi kẻ trộm cắp sẽ bị loại khỏi xứ. Mặt kia nói rằng mọi kẻ thề dối cũng sẽ bị loại bỏ.

ko.L: 그가 나에게 말하였다. "이것은 온 땅의 지면 위로 나가는 저주이다. 도둑질하는 자는 모두 그것에 따라 여기에서 깨끗이 제거되고, 맹세하는 자도 모두 그것에 따라 여기에서 깨끗이 제거될 것이다.
ko.B: 그러고 나서 그가 나에게 말했다. "이것은 온 땅 위로 나가는 저주이다. 한쪽에 적힌 대로 도둑은 모두 쓸려 나갈 것이고, 다른 쪽에 적힌 대로 거짓으로 맹세하는 자도 모두 쓸려 나갈 것이다.
ko.R: 그러고 나서 그가 나에게 말했다. "이것은 온 땅 위로 나가는 저주이다. 두루마리 한쪽에는 도둑질하는 사람은 모두 그 땅에서 없어질 것이라고 적혀 있다. 다른 쪽에는 거짓으로 맹세하는 사람도 모두 없어질 것이라고 적혀 있다.

decisions.choice: the curse: the curse written into God's covenant against those who break it
decisions.reason: The word is used for the oath that binds people to the covenant and the curses that fall on those who break it (Deuteronomy 29:11, 13, 19-20). The scroll is that written curse, now set loose against wrongdoers.

decisions.choice: will be purged out: will be cleared away from the land
decisions.reason: The verb means to be cleaned out, emptied, or acquitted. In the form used here it often means "go unpunished" (Exodus 21:19; Jeremiah 25:29), and some read the verse as a complaint: until now every thief has gone unpunished. The translation reads it as the result of the curse: the land will be cleansed of thieves and perjurers, which fits verse 4.

decisions.choice: from here ... according to it: as written on one side of the scroll and on the other
alternatives: from this place, according to the curse
decisions.reason: The words "from this" can mean "from here", that is, from the land, or "on this side", as in Exodus 32:15, where the tablets were written "on this side and on that side". Read the second way, one side of the scroll condemns stealing and the other swearing falsely. Both readings keep the point: the curse removes such people.

decisions.choice: stealing and swearing falsely: two of the Ten Commandments
decisions.reason: "You shall not steal" and "You shall not misuse the name of the LORD" (Exodus 20:7, 15) stand for the whole law: one sin wrongs a neighbor, the other wrongs God. Verse 4 makes plain that the swearing meant is swearing falsely by the LORD's name (Leviticus 19:12).

decisions.choice: as one side ... as the other side says (B); One side of the scroll says (R); swears falsely (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow the reading of the two sides (m3) and say "swears falsely", which verse 4 makes plain. "Swept away" (B) and "removed from the land" (R) give the sense chosen in m2.

decisions.choice: "la maldición"; "será limpiado de aquí conforme a ella" (L), "será barrido" (B), "será quitado de la tierra" (R)
decisions.reason: The levels follow the English: Literal keeps the Hebrew's "from here ... according to it", and Balanced and Readable take the reading of the scroll's two sides (m2, m3). The angel's words close at the end of verse 4.

decisions.choice: "lời nguyền rủa"; "khắp xứ"
decisions.reason: The land is the land of Judah, where the thieves and false swearers live, so Vietnamese says "xứ"; the angel's words close at the end of verse 4.

source.text: הוֹצֵאתִ֗יהָ נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּבָ֨אָה֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית הַגַּנָּ֔ב וְאֶל־בֵּ֛ית הַנִּשְׁבָּ֥ע בִּשְׁמִ֖י לַשָּׁ֑קֶר וְלָ֨נֶה֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ בֵּית֔וֹ וְכִלַּ֖תּוּ וְאֶת־עֵצָ֥יו וְאֶת־אֲבָנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: I have sent it out, declaration of Yahweh of hosts, and it will enter into [the] house of the thief and into [the] house of the one swearing by my name to falsehood, and it will lodge in [the] midst of his house and finish it, and its timbers and its stones.

en.L: I have sent it out, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, and it will come into the house of the thief and into the house of the one who swears by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name falsely; and it will lodge in the midst of {{gender:their|his}} house and consume it, both its timber and its stones."
en.B: I have sent it out, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, and it will go into the thief's house and the house of anyone who swears falsely by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name. It will stay inside that house and destroy it, timber and stones alike."
en.R: I am sending this curse out, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. It will go into the house of anyone who steals and the house of anyone who swears falsely by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name. It will stay in that house until it destroys it completely, both the wood and the stones."

es.L: Yo la he enviado, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, y entrará en la casa del ladrón y en la casa del que jura falsamente por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre; y se alojará en medio de su casa y la consumirá, tanto sus maderas como sus piedras».
es.B: La he enviado, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, y entrará en la casa del ladrón y en la casa de todo el que jura en falso por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre. Se quedará dentro de esa casa y la destruirá, maderas y piedras por igual».
es.R: Estoy enviando esta maldición, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. Entrará en la casa de todo el que roba y en la casa de todo el que jura en falso por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre. Se quedará en esa casa hasta destruirla por completo, tanto la madera como las piedras».

fr.L: Je l’ai fait sortir, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, et elle entrera dans la maison du voleur et dans la maison de celui qui jure faussement par {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom ; elle logera au milieu de sa maison et la consumera, son bois et ses pierres. »
fr.B: Je l’ai envoyée, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, et elle entrera dans la maison du voleur et dans la maison de quiconque jure faussement par {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom. Elle restera dans cette maison et la détruira, bois et pierres. »
fr.R: J’envoie cette malédiction, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. Elle entrera dans la maison de tous ceux qui volent et dans la maison de tous ceux qui font de faux serments en utilisant {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom. Elle restera dans cette maison jusqu’à la détruire complètement, le bois comme les pierres. »

sw.L: Nimeituma, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, nayo itaingia katika nyumba ya mwizi, na katika nyumba ya yeye aapaye kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} kwa uongo; nayo itakaa katikati ya nyumba yake na kuiteketeza, mbao zake na mawe yake."
sw.B: Nimeituma, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, nayo itaingia katika nyumba ya mwizi na nyumba ya kila mtu aapaye kwa uongo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}. Itakaa ndani ya nyumba hiyo na kuiharibu, mbao na mawe pia."
sw.R: Ninaituma laana hii, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. Itaingia katika nyumba ya kila mtu anayeiba na nyumba ya kila mtu anayeapa kwa uongo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}. Itakaa katika nyumba hiyo mpaka iiharibu kabisa, mbao na mawe pia."

vi.L: Ta đã sai nó ra, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, và nó sẽ vào nhà kẻ trộm và vào nhà kẻ lấy danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà thề dối; nó sẽ ở lại giữa nhà kẻ ấy và thiêu hủy nhà ấy, cả gỗ lẫn đá."
vi.B: Ta đã sai nó ra, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, và nó sẽ vào nhà kẻ trộm và nhà của bất cứ ai lấy danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà thề dối. Nó sẽ ở lại trong nhà ấy và phá hủy nhà ấy, cả gỗ lẫn đá."
vi.R: Ta đang sai lời nguyền rủa này ra, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. Nó sẽ vào nhà của bất cứ ai trộm cắp và nhà của bất cứ ai lấy danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà thề dối. Nó sẽ ở trong nhà ấy cho đến khi phá hủy hoàn toàn, cả gỗ lẫn đá."

ko.L: 내가 그것을 내보냈다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그것이 도둑의 집과 내 이름으로 거짓 맹세하는 자의 집에 들어가서, 그 집 가운데 머물며 그 집을 나무와 돌까지 다 없앨 것이다."
ko.B: 내가 그것을 내보냈다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그것이 도둑의 집과 내 이름으로 거짓 맹세하는 자의 집에 들어갈 것이다. 그리고 그 집 안에 머물며 나무와 돌까지 그 집을 허물어 버릴 것이다."
ko.R: 내가 이 저주를 내보낸다. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 이 저주는 도둑질하는 사람의 집과 내 이름으로 거짓 맹세하는 사람의 집에 들어갈 것이다. 그리고 그 집에 머물며 나무와 돌까지 그 집을 완전히 허물어 버릴 것이다."

decisions.choice: I have sent it out: the curse is already on its way
decisions.reason: The verb is in the form for a completed act: the LORD has released the curse, and it is flying (verse 1). It can also be read as a firm promise of what he will do.

decisions.choice: it will lodge in the house and consume it, timber and stones: like a plague that destroys a house
decisions.reason: The verb "lodge" means to stay overnight. The curse settles in the house and does not leave until nothing is left. The law about a house with a spreading growth in its walls ordered it torn down, "its stones, its timber and all the plaster" (Leviticus 14:45). The wrongdoer's house, built with stolen goods or false oaths, will not stand.

decisions.choice: swears by my name falsely: uses the LORD's name to make a lie seem true
decisions.reason: An oath in the LORD's name called on him as witness. To swear falsely by it was to make God a party to a lie (Leviticus 19:12; Jeremiah 7:9). The thief wrongs a neighbor; the false swearer wrongs both a neighbor and God.

decisions.choice: their / his (L); anyone who (B, R)
decisions.reason: The thief and the false swearer may be any man or woman, so Literal gives "his house" the gender setting, and Balanced and Readable say "anyone who" and "that house". Readable says "this curse" for "it", and "until it destroys it completely" for "consume". The closing quotation mark ends the angel's words begun in verse 3.

decisions.choice: "su casa", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "su" covers men and women, so the English gender setting is not needed.

decisions.choice: "sa maison", with no gender span
decisions.reason: French "sa" agrees with "maison" and says nothing of the owner's sex, so no gender setting is needed.

source.text: וַיֵּצֵ֕א הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י שָׂ֣א נָ֤א עֵינֶ֨יךָ֙ וּרְאֵ֔ה מָ֖ה הַיּוֹצֵ֥את הַזֹּֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: And went out the angel who talks with me and said to me, Lift up now your eyes and see what [is] this going out.

en.L: And the angel who talked with me went out and said to me, "Lift up your eyes, please, and see what this [is] that is going out."
en.B: Then the angel who talked with me stepped forward and told me, "Look up and see what this is that is coming out."
en.R: Then the angel who talked with me came forward. He said, "Look up and see what is coming out."

es.L: Y salió el ángel que hablaba conmigo y me dijo: «Alza ahora tus ojos y mira qué [es] esto que sale».
es.B: Entonces el ángel que hablaba conmigo se adelantó y me dijo: «Alza la vista y mira qué es esto que sale».
es.R: Entonces el ángel que hablaba conmigo se acercó. Me dijo: «Levanta la vista y mira lo que está saliendo».

fr.L: Et l’ange qui parlait avec moi sortit et me dit : « Lève donc les yeux et vois ce qu’[est] cette chose qui sort. »
fr.B: Alors l’ange qui parlait avec moi s’avança et me dit : « Lève les yeux et regarde ce qui sort là. »
fr.R: Ensuite, l’ange qui parlait avec moi s’est avancé. Il m’a dit : « Lève les yeux et regarde ce qui sort. »

sw.L: Naye malaika aliyezungumza nami akatoka, akaniambia, "Inua sasa macho yako, uone ni nini hiki kinachotoka."
sw.B: Kisha malaika aliyezungumza nami akasogea mbele, akaniambia, "Tazama juu uone ni nini hiki kinachotoka."
sw.R: Kisha malaika aliyezungumza nami akaja mbele. Akasema, "Tazama juu uone kinachotoka."

vi.L: Thiên sứ đang nói với tôi đi ra và bảo tôi: "Xin ông hãy ngước mắt lên và xem vật đang đi ra này [là] gì."
vi.B: Bấy giờ thiên sứ đang nói với tôi bước tới và bảo tôi: "Hãy ngước mắt lên xem vật đang đi ra đó là gì."
vi.R: Bấy giờ thiên sứ đang nói với tôi đến gần. Thiên sứ bảo: "Ông hãy nhìn lên và xem cái gì đang đi ra."

ko.L: 나와 말하던 천사가 나와서 나에게 말하였다. "눈을 들어 이 나오는 것이 무엇인지 보아라."
ko.B: 그때 나와 말하던 천사가 앞으로 나와서 나에게 말했다. "눈을 들어, 나오고 있는 이것이 무엇인지 보아라."
ko.R: 그때 나와 말하던 천사가 앞으로 나왔다. 그가 말했다. "위를 쳐다보고 무엇이 나오는지 보아라."

decisions.choice: the seventh vision: wickedness shut in a basket and carried off to Babylon
decisions.reason: Zechariah sees a measuring basket with a woman inside it. The angel calls her Wickedness, shuts her in, and two winged women carry the basket away to Shinar, where a house is built for it (verses 6-11). The flying scroll purged wrongdoers from the land; this vision removes wickedness itself, and sends it back to the land of the exile.

decisions.choice: going out: the same verb used for the angel, the curse and the basket
decisions.reason: The angel goes out, and the thing he points to is "going out", as the curse was in verse 3. The repeated verb ties the visions together: what is evil leaves the land.

decisions.choice: stepped forward (B); came forward (R); Look up (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "stepped forward" and "came forward", since the angel steps into view, and "Look up" for "lift up your eyes", as in 2:1. "Please" is left to the tone, as in 1:4.

source.text: וָאֹמַ֖ר מַה־הִ֑יא וַיֹּ֗אמֶר זֹ֤את הָֽאֵיפָה֙ הַיּוֹצֵ֔את וַיֹּ֕אמֶר זֹ֥את עֵינָ֖ם בְּכָל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I said, What [is] it? And he said, This [is] the ephah going out. And he said, This [is] their eye in all the land.

en.L: Then I said, "What [is] it?" He said, "This [is] the ephah going out." And he said, "This [is] their eye in all the land."
en.B: I asked, "What is it?" He said, "This is an ephah basket coming out." He added, "This is what they are like throughout the land."
en.R: I asked, "What is it?" He said, "It is a large basket for measuring grain, and it is coming out." He also said, "This shows what the people all over the land are like."

es.L: Y dije: «¿Qué [es]?». Y él dijo: «Esto [es] el efa que sale». Y dijo: «Este [es] su ojo en toda la tierra».
es.B: Pregunté: «¿Qué es?». Él dijo: «Es una canasta de un efa que sale». Y añadió: «Así son ellos en toda la tierra».
es.R: Pregunté: «¿Qué es?». Él dijo: «Es una canasta grande para medir grano, y está saliendo». También dijo: «Esto muestra cómo es la gente en toda la tierra».

fr.L: Et je dis : « Qu’[est]-ce ? » Et il dit : « C’est l’épha qui sort. » Et il dit : « C’est leur œil dans tout le pays. »
fr.B: Je demandai : « Qu’est-ce que c’est ? » Il dit : « C’est un boisseau qui sort. » Il ajouta : « Voilà à quoi ils ressemblent dans tout le pays. »
fr.R: J’ai demandé : « Qu’est-ce que c’est ? » Il a dit : « C’est un grand panier pour mesurer le grain, et il sort. » Il a ajouté : « Cela montre comment sont les gens dans tout le pays. »

sw.L: Nikasema, "Ni nini?" Naye akasema, "Hii [ndiyo] efa inayotoka." Akasema tena, "Hili [ndilo] jicho lao katika nchi yote."
sw.B: Nikauliza, "Ni nini?" Akasema, "Hiki ni kikapu cha efa kinachotoka." Akaongeza, "Hivi ndivyo walivyo katika nchi yote."
sw.R: Nikauliza, "Ni nini?" Akasema, "Ni kikapu kikubwa cha kupimia nafaka, nacho kinatoka." Akasema pia, "Hiki kinaonyesha jinsi watu walivyo katika nchi yote."

vi.L: Tôi nói: "Đó [là] gì?" Thiên sứ nói: "Đây [là] cái ê-pha đang đi ra." Rồi nói: "Đây [là] con mắt của chúng trong khắp xứ."
vi.B: Tôi hỏi: "Đó là gì?" Thiên sứ nói: "Đây là một cái thúng ê-pha đang đi ra." Thiên sứ nói thêm: "Đó là hình ảnh của chúng trong khắp xứ."
vi.R: Tôi hỏi: "Đó là gì?" Thiên sứ nói: "Đó là một cái thúng lớn dùng để đong lúa, và nó đang đi ra." Thiên sứ cũng nói: "Điều này cho thấy dân chúng khắp xứ là như thế nào."

ko.L: 내가 말하였다. "그것이 무엇입니까?" 그가 말하였다. "이것은 나오고 있는 에바이다." 또 말하였다. "이것은 온 땅에 있는 그들의 눈이다."
ko.B: 내가 물었다. "그것이 무엇입니까?" 그가 말했다. "이것은 나오고 있는 에바 바구니이다." 그가 또 말했다. "온 땅에 있는 그들의 모습이 이러하다."
ko.R: 내가 물었다. "그것이 무엇입니까?" 그가 말했다. "곡식을 되는 큰 바구니인데, 나오고 있다." 그가 또 말했다. "이것은 온 땅의 사람들이 어떠한지를 보여 준다."

decisions.choice: the ephah: a basket or container that held an ephah of grain
decisions.reason: An ephah was a measure for grain and flour, about 20 quarts by the reckoning used in the published books. Here the word means the container that held that amount, large enough for a woman to sit in (verse 7). Since a measure is used in trade, some see in it a hint of the cheating in business the prophets condemned (Amos 8:5; Micah 6:10-11).

decisions.choice: their eye: what they look like, their appearance
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "their eye", which can mean their look or appearance (Leviticus 13:55; Numbers 11:7), that is, what the people of the land are like. The Greek and Syriac translations read "their iniquity", a word that differs by one letter, which is very similar in shape in Hebrew writing. That reading makes the angel's meaning plainer, and many follow it. The translation keeps the Hebrew, whose sense is close: the basket shows the evil found throughout the land. This description of the ancient translations is written from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: the ephah (L); an ephah basket (B); a large basket for measuring grain (R); their eye (L); what they are like (B, R)
decisions.reason: The ephah is a container here, not an amount, so it takes no units setting. Literal keeps the Hebrew words; Balanced and Readable say what is meant. The basket keeps its image at every level.

decisions.choice: "el efa" (L), "una canasta de un efa" (B), "una canasta grande para medir grano" (R); "su ojo" (L), "así son ellos" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's "efa" and "canasta"; the container takes no units setting, since it is the basket and not an amount (m1). Literal keeps "their eye", and the other levels give the sense the English gives (m2).

decisions.choice: "l'épha" (L), "un boisseau" (B), "un grand panier pour mesurer le grain" (R); "leur œil" (L)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's "boisseau" (L, B) and "panier" (R) for the measuring basket; Literal keeps the Hebrew "ephah" and "their eye" (m1, m2).

decisions.choice: "efa" (L), "kikapu cha efa" (B), "kikapu kikubwa cha kupimia nafaka" (R); "jicho lao" (L)
decisions.reason: The ephah is the container here, not an amount, so it takes no units setting (m1); Literal keeps "their eye".

decisions.choice: "cái ê-pha" (L), "cái thúng ê-pha" (B), "một cái thúng lớn dùng để đong lúa" (R); "con mắt của chúng" (L)
decisions.reason: The ephah is the measuring container (m1); Literal keeps "their eye", and the other levels say what it means (m2).

decisions.choice: "에바" (L), "에바 바구니" (B), "곡식을 되는 큰 바구니" (R); "그들의 눈" (L)
decisions.reason: The ephah is the container (m1), so it takes no units setting; Literal keeps "their eye" and the other levels give its sense (m2).

source.text: וְהִנֵּ֛ה כִּכַּ֥ר עֹפֶ֖רֶת נִשֵּׂ֑את וְזֹאת֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה אַחַ֔ת יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בְּת֥וֹךְ הָאֵיפָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And look, a round cover of lead was lifted up, and this [was] a woman, one, sitting in [the] midst of the ephah.

en.L: And look, a round lid of lead was lifted up, and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah!
en.B: Then the lead cover was lifted, and there was a woman sitting inside the basket.
en.R: Then the lead cover of the basket was lifted, and I saw a woman sitting inside it.

es.L: Y he aquí, una tapa redonda de plomo fue levantada, y había una mujer sentada en medio del efa.
es.B: Entonces se levantó la tapa de plomo, y había una mujer sentada dentro de la canasta.
es.R: Entonces se levantó la tapa de plomo de la canasta, y vi a una mujer sentada adentro.

fr.L: Et voici, un couvercle rond de plomb fut soulevé, et il y avait une femme assise au milieu de l’épha !
fr.B: Alors le couvercle de plomb fut soulevé, et il y avait une femme assise dans le boisseau.
fr.R: Ensuite, le couvercle de plomb du panier a été soulevé, et j’ai vu une femme assise dedans.

sw.L: Na tazama, kifuniko cha mviringo cha risasi kiliinuliwa, na palikuwa na mwanamke mmoja ameketi katikati ya efa!
sw.B: Kisha kifuniko cha risasi kikainuliwa, na palikuwa na mwanamke ameketi ndani ya kikapu.
sw.R: Kisha kifuniko cha risasi cha kikapu kikainuliwa, nikamwona mwanamke ameketi ndani yake.

vi.L: Và kìa, một cái nắp tròn bằng chì được giở lên, và có một người đàn bà ngồi giữa cái ê-pha!
vi.B: Rồi cái nắp bằng chì được giở lên, và có một người đàn bà ngồi trong thúng.
vi.R: Rồi nắp chì của cái thúng được giở lên, và tôi thấy một người đàn bà ngồi bên trong.

ko.L: 그리고 보라, 둥근 납 뚜껑이 들어 올려졌는데, 에바 안에 한 여자가 앉아 있었다!
ko.B: 그때 납 뚜껑이 들어 올려지자, 바구니 안에 한 여자가 앉아 있었다.
ko.R: 그때 바구니의 납 뚜껑이 들어 올려졌다. 그러자 그 안에 한 여자가 앉아 있는 것이 보였다.

decisions.choice: a round lid of lead: a heavy disk of lead used as a cover
decisions.reason: The word means something round: a round loaf, a round district, or a disk of metal used as a weight, the talent (Exodus 25:39). Here it is a lead disk covering the basket. Lead is heavy, and the cover is meant to keep in what is inside.

decisions.choice: a woman: one woman, a figure in the vision
decisions.reason: "One woman" here means simply "a woman". Verse 8 says who she stands for.

decisions.choice: Then (B, R); look (L)
decisions.reason: As in 2:7, Balanced and Readable show "look" with "then" and say what Zechariah saw.

decisions.choice: "kifuniko cha risasi"
decisions.reason: "Risasi" is the metal lead, as in Exodus 15:10 and Ezekiel 22:18; the lid is heavy so that what is inside cannot get out (m1).

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ זֹ֣את הָרִשְׁעָ֔ה וַיַּשְׁלֵ֥ךְ אֹתָ֖הּ אֶל־תּ֣וֹךְ הָֽאֵיפָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁלֵ֛ךְ אֶת־אֶ֥בֶן הָעֹפֶ֖רֶת אֶל־פִּֽיהָ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he said, This [is] the wickedness. And he threw her into [the] midst of the ephah, and threw the stone of the lead on its mouth.

en.L: And he said, "This [is] Wickedness." And he cast her into the midst of the ephah, and cast the lead weight upon its mouth.
en.B: He said, "This is Wickedness." Then he pushed her back down into the basket and pressed the lead cover down over its opening.
en.R: The angel said, "This woman is Wickedness." Then he pushed her back down into the basket and slammed the heavy lead cover over the top.

es.L: Y dijo: «Esta [es] la Maldad». Y la arrojó en medio del efa, y arrojó la pesa de plomo sobre su boca.
es.B: Él dijo: «Esta es la Maldad». Luego la empujó de nuevo dentro de la canasta y apretó la tapa de plomo sobre la abertura.
es.R: El ángel dijo: «Esta mujer es la Maldad». Luego la empujó otra vez dentro de la canasta y cerró de golpe la pesada tapa de plomo.

fr.L: Et il dit : « C’est la Méchanceté. » Et il la jeta au milieu de l’épha, et jeta la masse de plomb sur son ouverture.
fr.B: Il dit : « C’est la Méchanceté. » Puis il la repoussa dans le boisseau et rabattit le couvercle de plomb sur l’ouverture.
fr.R: L’ange a dit : « Cette femme, c’est la Méchanceté. » Puis il l’a repoussée dans le panier et il a refermé d’un coup le lourd couvercle de plomb.

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Huyu [ndiye] Uovu." Akamtupa katikati ya efa, akatupa lile jiwe la risasi juu ya kinywa chake.
sw.B: Akasema, "Huyu ndiye Uovu." Kisha akamsukuma tena ndani ya kikapu, akakandamiza kifuniko cha risasi juu ya mdomo wake.
sw.R: Malaika akasema, "Mwanamke huyu ndiye Uovu." Kisha akamsukuma tena ndani ya kikapu, akakifunga kwa nguvu kwa kifuniko kizito cha risasi.

vi.L: Thiên sứ nói: "Đây [là] Sự Gian Ác." Rồi thiên sứ quăng người đàn bà vào giữa cái ê-pha, và quăng cục chì lên miệng nó.
vi.B: Thiên sứ nói: "Đây là Sự Gian Ác." Rồi thiên sứ đẩy người đàn bà trở vào trong thúng và đậy nắp chì lên miệng thúng.
vi.R: Thiên sứ nói: "Người đàn bà này là Sự Gian Ác." Rồi thiên sứ đẩy bà ta trở vào thúng và đóng mạnh nắp chì nặng lên trên.

ko.L: 그가 말하였다. "이것은 악이다." 그리고 그가 그 여자를 에바 속에 던져 넣고, 그 아가리에 납 덩이를 던져 덮었다.
ko.B: 그가 말했다. "이 여자는 악이다." 그러고는 그 여자를 바구니 안으로 다시 밀어 넣고, 납 뚜껑으로 그 입구를 눌러 덮었다.
ko.R: 천사가 말했다. "이 여자는 바로 악이다." 그러고는 그 여자를 다시 바구니 안으로 밀어 넣고, 무거운 납 뚜껑을 쾅 덮어 버렸다.

decisions.choice: Wickedness: all the wrongdoing of the land, pictured as a woman
decisions.reason: The word means wickedness or guilt. In Hebrew it is a feminine noun, so in the vision it takes the form of a woman, as wisdom and folly are pictured as women in Proverbs (Proverbs 9:1-6, 13-18). The figure stands for the sin of the whole land, not for women. The angel names her, shuts her in, and in the verses that follow she is carried away.

decisions.choice: thrown back and shut in: wickedness is held fast so that it cannot escape
decisions.reason: The woman seems to rise when the lid is lifted, and the angel forces her back and seals the basket with the heavy lead. Wickedness is no longer free in the land; it is under God's control and about to be removed.

decisions.choice: Wickedness, capitalized, at every level
decisions.reason: The angel uses the word as a name for the woman in the vision, so it is capitalized. Readable says "This woman is", and "the heavy lead cover" for "the weight of lead", to keep the picture clear.

decisions.choice: "la Maldad", capitalized
decisions.reason: The angel uses the word as the name of the figure, so it is capitalized, as in the English; "maldad" is feminine in Spanish, as the Hebrew word is (m1).

decisions.choice: "la Méchanceté", capitalized
decisions.reason: A feminine noun used as the name of the woman in the vision, as the Hebrew word is feminine (m1).

decisions.choice: "Uovu", capitalized
decisions.reason: The word is used as the name of the figure, so it is capitalized; Swahili has no grammatical gender, so the woman of the vision carries the picture (m1).

decisions.choice: "Sự Gian Ác", capitalized as a name
decisions.reason: The angel names the figure, so the word is written as a name, as the English capitalizes it; it stands for the land's sin, not for women (m1).
Korean has no capital letters, so the name is given plainly as 악, the figure being named by the angel (m1).

source.text: וָאֶשָּׂ֨א עֵינַ֜י וָאֵ֗רֶא וְהִנֵּה֩ שְׁתַּ֨יִם נָשִׁ֤ים יֽוֹצְאוֹת֙ וְר֣וּחַ בְּכַנְפֵיהֶ֔ם וְלָהֵ֥נָּה כְנָפַ֖יִם כְּכַנְפֵ֣י הַחֲסִידָ֑ה וַתִּשֶּׂ֨אנָה֙ אֶת־הָ֣אֵיפָ֔ה בֵּ֥ין הָאָ֖רֶץ וּבֵ֥ין הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I lifted up my eyes and saw, and look, two women going out, and wind in their wings, and they had wings like [the] wings of the stork; and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heavens.

en.L: And I lifted up my eyes and saw, and look, two women coming out, with wind in their wings; and they had wings like the wings of the stork, and they lifted the ephah between the earth and the heavens.
en.B: Then I looked up, and there were two women coming out, with the wind in their wings. They had wings like a stork's wings, and they lifted the basket up between earth and sky.
en.R: Then I looked up and saw two women flying out with the wind in their wings. Their wings were like the wings of a stork. They lifted the basket up into the air, between the earth and the sky.

es.L: Y alcé mis ojos y miré, y he aquí dos mujeres que salían, y [había] viento en sus alas; y tenían alas como alas de cigüeña, y levantaron el efa entre la tierra y los cielos.
es.B: Luego alcé la vista, y vi a dos mujeres que salían, con el viento en sus alas. Tenían alas como de cigüeña, y levantaron la canasta entre la tierra y el cielo.
es.R: Luego levanté la vista y vi a dos mujeres que salían volando con el viento en sus alas. Sus alas eran como las de una cigüeña. Levantaron la canasta por el aire, entre la tierra y el cielo.

fr.L: Et je levai les yeux et je regardai, et voici, deux femmes sortaient, et le vent [était] dans leurs ailes ; elles avaient des ailes comme les ailes de la cigogne, et elles soulevèrent l’épha entre la terre et les cieux.
fr.B: Puis je levai les yeux, et je vis deux femmes qui sortaient, le vent dans leurs ailes. Elles avaient des ailes comme celles de la cigogne, et elles soulevèrent le boisseau entre la terre et le ciel.
fr.R: Ensuite, j’ai levé les yeux et j’ai vu deux femmes qui sortaient en volant, le vent dans leurs ailes. Leurs ailes étaient comme celles d’une cigogne. Elles ont soulevé le panier dans les airs, entre la terre et le ciel.

sw.L: Nikainua macho yangu, nikaona, na tazama, wanawake wawili wakitoka, na upepo [ulikuwa] katika mabawa yao; nao walikuwa na mabawa kama mabawa ya korongo, nao wakaiinua efa kati ya nchi na mbingu.
sw.B: Kisha nikatazama juu, na palikuwa na wanawake wawili wakitoka, upepo ukiwa katika mabawa yao. Walikuwa na mabawa kama ya korongo, nao wakakiinua kikapu kati ya nchi na anga.
sw.R: Kisha nikatazama juu nikaona wanawake wawili wakiruka nje, upepo ukiwa katika mabawa yao. Mabawa yao yalikuwa kama mabawa ya korongo. Wakakiinua kikapu juu angani, kati ya nchi na anga.

vi.L: Tôi ngước mắt lên và nhìn, và kìa, hai người đàn bà đi ra, có gió trong cánh của họ; họ có cánh như cánh con cò, và họ nhấc cái ê-pha lên giữa đất và trời.
vi.B: Rồi tôi ngước mắt lên, thấy có hai người đàn bà đi ra, gió lộng trong cánh của họ. Họ có cánh giống như cánh cò, và họ nhấc cái thúng lên giữa đất và trời.
vi.R: Rồi tôi nhìn lên và thấy hai người đàn bà bay ra, gió lộng trong cánh họ. Cánh của họ giống như cánh con cò. Họ nhấc cái thúng lên không trung, giữa đất và trời.

ko.L: 내가 눈을 들어 보니, 보라, 두 여자가 나오는데, 그들의 날개에 바람이 [있었다]. 그들에게는 황새의 날개 같은 날개가 있었고, 그들이 에바를 땅과 하늘 사이로 들어 올렸다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 내가 눈을 들어 보니, 두 여자가 날개에 바람을 받으며 나오고 있었다. 그들의 날개는 황새의 날개 같았다. 그들이 바구니를 땅과 하늘 사이로 들어 올렸다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 나는 위를 쳐다보다가 두 여자가 날개에 바람을 받으며 날아 나오는 것을 보았다. 그들의 날개는 황새 날개 같았다. 그들은 바구니를 들고 땅과 하늘 사이 공중으로 날아올랐다.

decisions.choice: the stork: a large bird with broad, strong wings
decisions.reason: The stork is a large bird that migrates over the land of Israel in spring and autumn, flying great distances (Jeremiah 8:7). Its wide wings suit the carrying of a heavy load far away. The law counts it among the unclean birds (Leviticus 11:19), which some see as fitting for those who carry wickedness.

decisions.choice: wind in their wings: the wind carries them
decisions.reason: The word means wind, breath or spirit. Here it is the wind that fills their wings and carries them, so that the basket is lifted and borne away.

decisions.choice: two women: bearers in the vision, not explained
decisions.reason: The angel does not say who the women are. They are simply the means by which the basket is carried away. Like the woman in the basket, they are part of the picture.

decisions.choice: I looked up (B, R); between earth and sky (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "looked up", as in 2:1, and "sky" for "heavens", which here means the air above the earth.

decisions.choice: "cigüeña"
decisions.reason: The stork of Jeremiah 8:7 and Leviticus 11:19 (m1).

decisions.choice: "황새"
decisions.reason: The stork is 황새 in modern Korean; 학 is the crane.

source.text: וָאֹמַ֕ר אֶל־הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑י אָ֛נָה הֵ֥מָּה מֽוֹלִכ֖וֹת אֶת־הָאֵיפָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I said to the angel who talks with me, Where [are] they taking the ephah?

en.L: And I said to the angel who talked with me, "Where are they taking the ephah?"
en.B: I asked the angel who talked with me, "Where are they taking the basket?"
en.R: I asked the angel who talked with me, "Where are they taking the basket?"

es.L: Y dije al ángel que hablaba conmigo: «¿Adónde llevan ellas el efa?».
es.B: Le pregunté al ángel que hablaba conmigo: «¿Adónde llevan la canasta?».
es.R: Le pregunté al ángel que hablaba conmigo: «¿Adónde se llevan la canasta?».

fr.L: Et je dis à l’ange qui parlait avec moi : « Où emportent-elles l’épha ? »
fr.B: Je demandai à l’ange qui parlait avec moi : « Où emportent-elles le boisseau ? »
fr.R: J’ai demandé à l’ange qui parlait avec moi : « Où emportent-elles le panier ? »

sw.L: Nikamwambia malaika aliyezungumza nami, "Wanaipeleka efa wapi?"
sw.B: Nikamwuliza malaika aliyezungumza nami, "Wanakipeleka kikapu wapi?"
sw.R: Nikamwuliza malaika aliyezungumza nami, "Wanakipeleka wapi kikapu hicho?"

vi.L: Tôi nói với thiên sứ đang nói với tôi: "Họ mang cái ê-pha đi đâu?"
vi.B: Tôi hỏi thiên sứ đang nói với tôi: "Họ mang cái thúng đi đâu vậy?"
vi.R: Tôi hỏi thiên sứ đang nói với tôi: "Họ đem cái thúng đi đâu vậy?"

ko.L: 내가 나와 말하던 천사에게 말하였다. "그들이 에바를 어디로 가져갑니까?"
ko.B: 내가 나와 말하던 천사에게 물었다. "저들이 바구니를 어디로 가져갑니까?"
ko.R: 내가 나와 말하던 천사에게 물었다. "저 여자들이 바구니를 어디로 가져가는 것입니까?"

decisions.choice: where are they taking it: the prophet's last question in this vision
decisions.reason: Zechariah asks where wickedness is going, and the angel's answer in verse 11 ends the vision.

decisions.choice: the basket (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word for the ephah basket follows verse 6.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י לִבְנֽוֹת־לָ֥הֿ בַ֖יִת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ שִׁנְעָ֑ר וְהוּכַ֛ן וְהֻנִּ֥יחָה שָּׁ֖ם עַל־מְכֻנָתָֽהּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he said to me, To build for it a house in [the] land of Shinar; and it will be prepared, and it will be set there on its base.

en.L: And he said to me, "To build a house for it in the land of Shinar; and when it is prepared, it will be set down there on its own base."
en.B: He answered, "To the land of Shinar, to build a house for it. When the house is ready, the basket will be set down there on its base."
en.R: He answered, "To Babylonia. A temple will be built for it there. When the temple is ready, the basket will be set there on its stand."

es.L: Y me dijo: «Para edificarle una casa en la tierra de Sinar; y cuando esté preparada, será puesta allí sobre su base».
es.B: Él respondió: «A la tierra de Sinar, para edificarle una casa. Cuando la casa esté lista, la canasta será puesta allí sobre su base».
es.R: Él respondió: «A Babilonia. Allí le van a construir un templo. Cuando el templo esté listo, pondrán la canasta allí sobre su pedestal».

fr.L: Et il me dit : « Pour lui bâtir une maison au pays de Shinéar ; et quand elle sera prête, il sera déposé là sur son socle. »
fr.B: Il répondit : « Au pays de Shinéar, pour lui bâtir une maison. Quand la maison sera prête, le boisseau y sera posé sur son socle. »
fr.R: Il a répondu : « En Babylonie. On va lui construire un temple là-bas. Quand le temple sera prêt, on y posera le panier sur son socle. »

sw.L: Naye akaniambia, "Ili kuijengea nyumba katika nchi ya Shinari; na itakapokuwa tayari, itawekwa huko juu ya kitako chake."
sw.B: Akajibu, "Katika nchi ya Shinari, ili kukijengea nyumba. Nyumba hiyo itakapokuwa tayari, kikapu kitawekwa huko juu ya kitako chake."
sw.R: Akajibu, "Babeli. Huko kitajengewa hekalu. Hekalu hilo litakapokuwa tayari, kikapu kitawekwa huko juu ya kitako chake."

vi.L: Thiên sứ nói với tôi: "Để xây cho nó một cái nhà trong xứ Si-nê-a; và khi nhà đã sẵn sàng, nó sẽ được đặt ở đó trên bệ của nó."
vi.B: Thiên sứ đáp: "Đến xứ Si-nê-a, để xây cho nó một cái nhà. Khi nhà ấy xong, cái thúng sẽ được đặt ở đó trên bệ của nó."
vi.R: Thiên sứ đáp: "Đến Ba-by-lôn. Người ta sẽ xây cho nó một cái đền ở đó. Khi đền ấy xong, cái thúng sẽ được đặt trên bệ của nó."

ko.L: 그가 나에게 말하였다. "시날 땅에서 그것을 위하여 집을 지으려는 것이다. 그 집이 준비되면, 그것이 거기 그 받침 위에 놓일 것이다."
ko.B: 그가 대답했다. "시날 땅으로 가서 그것을 위해 집을 지으려는 것이다. 집이 준비되면 바구니가 거기 받침대 위에 놓일 것이다."
ko.R: 그가 대답했다. "바빌로니아로 간다. 그곳에 그것을 위한 신전이 세워질 것이다. 신전이 준비되면 바구니가 거기 받침대 위에 놓일 것이다."

decisions.choice: the land of Shinar: Babylonia
decisions.reason: Shinar is the old name of the land of Babylon (Genesis 10:10; 11:2, where the tower of Babel was built; Daniel 1:2). It is the place of human pride against God and the place of Judah's exile. Wickedness is sent back to the land it came from, and the land of Judah is left clean.

decisions.choice: a house ... on its base: a shrine where the basket will stand like an idol
decisions.reason: "House" is the word for a temple as well as a home, and the base is a stand or pedestal (the same word is used for the stands of Solomon's temple, 1 Kings 7:27). Wickedness will be set up in Babylon like an idol in its shrine, while in Jerusalem the LORD's house is being built.

decisions.choice: Babylonia (R); a temple (R); stand (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "Babylonia" for Shinar and "temple" for "house", which is what the house is (m2). Balanced and Readable name "the house" and "the basket" where the Hebrew says "it".

decisions.choice: "la tierra de Sinar" (L, B), "Babilonia" (R)
decisions.reason: The published form of Genesis 10:10 and Daniel 1:2; Readable gives the plain name of the land, as the English Readable does (m1).

decisions.choice: "le pays de Shinéar" (L, B), "la Babylonie" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's "Shinéar"; Readable names the land, as the English Readable says "Babylonia".

decisions.choice: "nchi ya Shinari" (L, B), "Babeli" (R)
decisions.reason: The published "Shinari" of Genesis 10:10; Readable names Babylon, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "xứ Si-nê-a" (L, B), "Ba-by-lôn" (R)
decisions.reason: The published "Si-nê-a" (Genesis 10:10); Readable names Babylon, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "시날 땅" (L, B), "바빌로니아" (R); "신전" (R)
decisions.reason: The published 시날 (Genesis 10:10; Daniel 1:2); Readable names Babylonia and calls the house a 신전, a heathen shrine, as the English Readable says "temple" (m2).
